label: r2-fixtures-prior-tip
command:
"""B-R2-1 / B-1 regression fixtures as a standalone behavioural probe, using ONLY each
tree's own public API (build_reference_index, id_correctness, load_lineage, score_leg),
so the same code runs against the previous tip a0c0115a and the repaired tip.
Exit 0 iff the repaired behaviour holds. Nothing in the primary checkout is written:
it is only read (the old code reads its working-tree caches; the new code runs
git rev-parse / git cat-file there)."""
import collections
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import t2pw.bench.eval_v2.reactions as R
from t2pw.bench.eval_v2.gold import load_supplement

print("reactions module:", R.__file__)
arm = sys.argv[1]
tmp = Path("C:/t/bt/eval/probe_r2") / arm
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
(tmp / "data").mkdir(parents=True)


def write(mapper_name, kegg_name):
    (tmp / "data/id_mapping_cache.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"compounds": {"x": {"candidates": [{"name": mapper_name, "pathbank_compound_id": 9}]}}}))
    (tmp / "data/enrichment_cache.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"compounds": {"kegg:C00019": {"status": "ok", "primary_name": kegg_name}}}))
    (tmp / "data/pathwhiz_id_db.json").write_text("{}")


git = ["git", "-C", str(tmp)]
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(tmp)], check=True)
write("Glycine", "S-Adenosyl-L-methionine")
subprocess.run(git + ["add", "data"], check=True)
subprocess.run(git + ["-c", "user.email=eval@t2pw.local", "-c", "user.name=ORCH-742c",
                      "commit", "-q", "-m", "tables"], check=True)
write("Serine", "Oxoglutaric acid")
sam = {"entities": {"compounds": [{"name": "S-adenosyl-L-methionine", "mapped_ids": {"kegg": "C00019"}}]}}
fixture = R.id_correctness(sam, R.build_reference_index(tmp))["counts"]

# The reviewer's measurement: the same committed canonical legs (C:/t/eval), judged
# against a reference built from the primary checkout, whose caches are dirty.
repo = Path("C:/t/eval")
rd = R.load_lineage(repo)
ref = R.build_reference_index(Path("C:/Users/Angad/Desktop/SummerBIOIN/Project14-T2PW"))
c = collections.Counter()
for p in rd.committed_paths(repo):
    if p.endswith("/final_mapped.json"):
        payload = rd.load_json(repo / p)
        if isinstance(payload, dict):
            c.update(R.id_correctness(payload, ref)["counts"])

case = load_supplement()["PMC12657337"]
row = {"inputs": ["pyruvate"], "outputs": ["acetate"], "enzymes": ["pyruvate oxidase"]}
poxb = R.score_leg(case, {"processes": {"reactions": [row]}}, [], None)["rows"][0]
out = {"B_R2_1_dirty_tree_fixture": fixture,
       "B_R2_1_primary_checkout_reference": {k: c[k] for k in ("correct_identity", "wrong_identity")},
       "B_R2_1_tables": ref.get("tables", "NOT RECORDED"),
       "B_1_poxb_row": {"class": poxb["class"], "gold_ids": poxb.get("gold_ids")}}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
ok = (fixture == {"correct_identity": 1}
      and out["B_R2_1_primary_checkout_reference"] == {"correct_identity": 1184, "wrong_identity": 119}
      and poxb["class"] == "paper_stated_off_pathway" and poxb.get("gold_ids") == ["O3"])
print("REPAIRED BEHAVIOUR HOLDS" if ok else "REPAIRED BEHAVIOUR DOES NOT HOLD")
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
